payload.description: Lets your Agents know where you are, what the weather is like there and what game you are playing. Presence quietly works out where you probably are (home, elsewhere, or unknown), how sure it is, and what is going on around you: local weather and, if you add Steam, your current game. Your Agents then answer with that in mind. It is not a tracker for other people and has no screen of its own, only a settings tab. Everything is optional and you stay in control.
